name: vscode-codex-customise
description: Custom TODO triggers, prompts and destination threads for Codex.

codexCustomise.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable custom TODO actions. Run **Codex Customise: Enable Custom TODOs** to replace the official Codex TODO CodeLens in the workspace, then reload VS Code.

codexCustomise.trigger.description: Exact text to match anywhere on a line, such as TODO, //TASK or %codex. Matching is case-sensitive.

codexCustomise.message.markdownDescription: TODO message template. Press Enter to add a new line. Placeholders: `{comment}`, `{file}`, `{relativeFile}`, `{line}`, `{workspace}`. Leave empty to use the default Codex TODO prompt.

codexCustomise.targetThreadId.markdownDescription: Destination Codex thread ID. Run **Codex Customise: Select TODO Target Thread** to choose a local thread. Leave empty to create a new thread for each TODO.

codexCustomise.codexPath.description: Codex executable path. Empty locates the CLI in the official extension or PATH.

codexCustomise.codexHome.description: Optional Codex data directory. Empty uses the existing CODEX_HOME or Codex default. The selected thread must belong to this directory.
